list.name: tenantId
list.label: Tenant
list.definition: SELECT t.tenant_name AS __text, t.tenant_id AS __value FROM grafana_tenants t JOIN grafana_user_tenant_scope scope ON scope.user_email = lower('${__user.email}') WHERE scope.is_active = true AND (scope.is_super_admin OR t.tenant_id = scope.tenant_id) ORDER BY t.tenant_name
list.query: SELECT t.tenant_name AS __text, t.tenant_id AS __value FROM grafana_tenants t JOIN grafana_user_tenant_scope scope ON scope.user_email = lower('${__user.email}') WHERE scope.is_active = true AND (scope.is_super_admin OR t.tenant_id = scope.tenant_id) ORDER BY t.tenant_name

list.name: effectiveTenantFilter
list.label: Effective Tenant Filter
list.definition: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM grafana_user_tenant_scope scope WHERE scope.user_email = lower('${__user.email}') AND scope.is_active = true AND scope.is_super_admin = true) THEN CASE WHEN '${tenantId}' = '.*' THEN '.*' ELSE '${tenantId}' END ELSE (SELECT scope.tenant_id FROM grafana_user_tenant_scope scope WHERE scope.user_email = lower('${__user.email}') AND scope.is_active = true LIMIT 1) END AS __value
list.query: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM grafana_user_tenant_scope scope WHERE scope.user_email = lower('${__user.email}') AND scope.is_active = true AND scope.is_super_admin = true) THEN CASE WHEN '${tenantId}' = '.*' THEN '.*' ELSE '${tenantId}' END ELSE (SELECT scope.tenant_id FROM grafana_user_tenant_scope scope WHERE scope.user_email = lower('${__user.email}') AND scope.is_active = true LIMIT 1) END AS __value

list.name: effectiveTenantNameFilter
list.label: Effective Tenant Name Filter
list.definition: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM grafana_user_tenant_scope scope WHERE scope.user_email = lower('${__user.email}') AND scope.is_active = true AND scope.is_super_admin = true) THEN CASE WHEN '${tenantId}' = '.*' THEN '.*' ELSE (SELECT regexp_replace(t.tenant_name, '([\\.\^\$\*\+\?\(\)\[\]\{\}\|])', '\\\\\1', 'g') FROM grafana_tenants t WHERE t.tenant_id = '${tenantId}' LIMIT 1) END ELSE (SELECT regexp_replace(t.tenant_name, '([\\.\^\$\*\+\?\(\)\[\]\{\}\|])', '\\\\\1', 'g') FROM grafana_user_tenant_scope scope JOIN grafana_tenants t ON t.tenant_id = scope.tenant_id WHERE scope.user_email = lower('${__user.email}') AND scope.is_active = true LIMIT 1) END AS __value
list.query: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM grafana_user_tenant_scope scope WHERE scope.user_email = lower('${__user.email}') AND scope.is_active = true AND scope.is_super_admin = true) THEN CASE WHEN '${tenantId}' = '.*' THEN '.*' ELSE (SELECT regexp_replace(t.tenant_name, '([\\.\^\$\*\+\?\(\)\[\]\{\}\|])', '\\\\\1', 'g') FROM grafana_tenants t WHERE t.tenant_id = '${tenantId}' LIMIT 1) END ELSE (SELECT regexp_replace(t.tenant_name, '([\\.\^\$\*\+\?\(\)\[\]\{\}\|])', '\\\\\1', 'g') FROM grafana_user_tenant_scope scope JOIN grafana_tenants t ON t.tenant_id = scope.tenant_id WHERE scope.user_email = lower('${__user.email}') AND scope.is_active = true LIMIT 1) END AS __value

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tenant_name, operation, table) (rate(database_query_duration_seconds_bucket{tenant_id=~"$effectiveTenantFilter"}[5m])))
